+    # Add points

+        if i < points_with_times:

+import sys

+
+import gpxpy
+from gpxpy.gpx import GPXTrackPoint, GPXTrackSegment
+from datetime import datetime
+
+def test_case(name, points_with_times, total_points, expected):
+    segment = GPXTrackSegment()
+    
+    # Add points
+    for i in range(total_points):
+        if i < points_with_times:
+            point = GPXTrackPoint(latitude=10, longitude=10, time=datetime.now())
+        else:
+            point = GPXTrackPoint(latitude=10, longitude=10)
+        segment.points.append(point)
+    
+    # Override first and last points to have times if needed for our new logic
+    if total_points > 0:
+        if points_with_times > 0:
+            segment.points[0].time = datetime.now()
+        if points_with_times > 0:
+            segment.points[-1].time = datetime.now()
+            
+        # But if we're testing with fewer points having times, we need to remove times
+        if points_with_times < total_points:
+            # Remove times from some middle points
+            start_remove = max(1, points_with_times)  # Don't touch first
+            end_remove = min(total_points - 1, total_points)  # Don't touch last
+            for i in range(start_remove, end_remove):
+                if i > points_with_times - 1:  # We want exactly points_with_times to have times
+                    segment.points[i].time = None
+    
+    has_times = segment.has_times()
+    status = "PASS" if has_times == expected else "FAIL"
+    print(f"{name}: {status} (expected {expected}, got {has_times})")
+
+# Test cases
+test_case("Empty segment", 0, 0, True)  # Special case handled separately
+test_case("1 point with time", 1, 1, False)  # Less than 3 points
+test_case("2 points with times", 2, 2, False)  # Less than 3 points
+test_case("3 points all with times", 3, 3, True)  # Exactly 3 points, all with times
+test_case("4 points, 3 with times (75%)", 3, 4, True)  # Exactly 75%
+test_case("4 points, 2 with times (50%)", 2, 4, False)  # Less than 75%
+test_case("10 points, 8 with times (80%)", 8, 10, True)  # More than 75%
